claims.statement: Complete ordered divisor-channel bijection with complementary orientation and inverse delta=n^2/gcd(Ry-na,n^2).
Exact individual-prime diagonal certificate count and relative density one in every fixed reduced progression of residue one modulo four.

claims.statement: The centered Bezout opening has positive A11 for every real delta>0.
claims.counterexample: r=2,t=1,delta=1/8: all companions have x odd, so A11<=-1/2.
claims.repair: For positive integer channel orders positivity holds; the exact fixed-companion condition is delta>(x/r)^2.
